Worst Experience
Apr 2021 • Friends
Went here for a birthday, the experience given is 1-star because I can't give it zero stars for a "supposedly" 5-star restaurant.

Why? Let me list the issues:

1. We booked a reservation, but the table provided didn't have proper air-conditioning (AC). They used one of those crappy portal AC units trying to cool down the clients.

2. We have been to several 5-star buffets throughout Saigon and never had a issue with being "bloated" while we had only had 1-2 plates a person. I suspect the restaurant adds a ton of baking soda into the food. Baking soda acts as a bloating agent in the human body causing the sensation of being "full". This is quite disgraceful because the bloating effect lasts for two days straight.

3. Pricing is set at 1.8 million dong per person, which is more expensive than the buffet in Nikko Hotel and many other buffets in Saigon. For the price, the food was not worth the money.

Overall experience: I would NEVER go here again and would NOT recommend this place to anyone else. Choose another 5-stars restaurant and not this imposter of a restaurant.

Save yourself the trouble and money!

Nice posh place but disappointing food
Apr 2019 • Business
We visited this restaurant at Gem Centre to meet up with some business associates. The restaurant has a very nice decor and the ambience is perfect for couples as it is quite dimly lit. 

However, when we wanted to order some whisky which are in the menu, we were informed that the drinks are not available. 

My colleague ordered a medium rare rib eye steak but the steak came medium. He then asked for a change in the steak. The oysters, however, were fresh. I ordered the baked cod and it was quite good but the serving was small. 

This would be a nice place to impress your date given the cosy ambience.

Disappointing Dinner
Feb 2019 • Family
There are 2 incidents that disappointing the family a lot. 
1st - I called at 2.30pm today to book the table for 5 tonight 6pm under the name of Foo. When we arrived at the restaurant, the waitress said cannot find my booking. I show her my outgoing call to the restaurant phone number has a record of one minute conversation. So apparently someone answer the call did not make the reservation for me. Anyway the waitress is getting us a table immediately.

2nd - when we asked for the bill, I notice they are charging my 9 year old boy at full price and the price per person is more expensive than their pricing in their website. I asked the man whom send me the bill (he claim his band is Ha and he is the restaurant supervisor) why there was a different, he said i did not read the information in the internet properly. Apparently they did not update the price in every related page. The page that I read is still the old price. 

The restaurant is not located inside any 5 star hotel but their price is no different from the hotel. Yet it is more expensive as their children price (child must not be taller than 120cm) is 70% of the adult price. Any children that is taller than 120cm will be charged at adult price at VND1.5mil. This is obviously over priced. We will not go back to this place again. NEVER!!!
